title: Expanding Access to Evidence-Based Suicide Risk Assessment and Intervention in a Crisis Stabilization Setting
official: Expanding Access to Evidence-Based Suicide Risk Assessment and Intervention in a Crisis Stabilization Setting (Patient Informants and RCT)
summary: The overarching goal of this project is to expand access to evidence-based suicide risk assessment, safety planning, and intervention among patients at elevated suicide risk by implementing Jaspr in a real-world psychiatric setting.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 18 and older
* Able to read, write, and understand English well enough to complete study procedures
* Presence of past-month active suicidal ideation (i.e., Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale \[C-SSRS\] screener \>1) and/or past three-month suicidal behavior, verified by the C-SSRS screener
* Owns a smartphone compatible with downloading the Jaspr-at-Home app

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medically or cognitively unable to participate in study procedures (e.g., current psychotic symptoms),
* Psychosocial factors influencing ability to complete study procedures (e.g., pending incarceration)
